picks.editorial_note: MIT's Regina Barzilay and James Collins won the prestigious Pritzker Prize for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, validating years of work at the intersection of deep learning and bioengineering against the urgent global threat of antibiotic resistance.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge team's AI-guided 'plug and play' vaccine design achieved complete protection against diverse bird flu variants in animal trials, a concrete demonstration of AI accelerating defenses against pandemic-threat pathogens.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC researchers built WorldParticle, a single deep-learning model that simulates physical phenomena as varied as sliding sand and protein folding, pointing toward a unifying approach for scientific simulation across disciplines.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to $100 billion in equity to the public, alongside SpaceX's giveaways, raises major questions about how AI's enormous wealth creation should be distributed — a defining policy and economic question for the industry.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: Reported ties between Nvidia's CEO and a figure linked to a suspected Chinese espionage case spotlight the national security stakes tangled up in the AI chip supply chain at the center of US-China tech competition.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security

picks.editorial_note: TUM's new Munich site for the German Center for Future Mobility, backed by up to €20 million in federal funding, signals serious government investment in AI-driven autonomous public transportation.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, building toward a joint lab, links top academic AI research directly to a leading commercial robotics platform — a bellwether for embodied AI's path to market.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to push research into 'sovereign' industrial AI applications reflects Europe's broader push for technological independence in agentic AI, robotics, and cybersecurity.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' with Fermilab building agentic tools to automate scientific ML workflows, shows national labs institutionalizing AI agents as infrastructure for the broader Genesis Mission.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2 million NIST award to build a Digital Twin Technology Lab ties AI and robotics directly to semiconductor manufacturing capacity and workforce training, a priority area for US industrial policy.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training
